currentEvidence.conclusion: Current deterministic characterization does not reproduce the historical failure; no fix/pass/false-positive conclusion is claimed.

measurements.foreground: Record getComputedStyle color and alpha at the exact rendered element.
measurements.background: Resolve the effective composited background through every ancestor, including alpha, image, gradient, overlay, filter, backdrop-filter, and blend mode.
measurements.pixelSampling: Sample rendered foreground and background pixels adjacent to each glyph and retain coordinates and screenshots as disposable candidate evidence.
measurements.imageGradientBackdrop: Test every state in which imagery, gradients, translucent overlays, video/media frames, or backdrop effects intersect the status labels.
